objective: Sherman QC scan-only F1 bend-line generalization

v2.failure_mode: Family-pooled candidate confidence selected repeated strong lines but did not generalize ownership; three families were completely undercalled.

v3.remaining_failure_mode: Precision transferred, but recall remained poor and one seven-object family was completely undercalled.

visual_findings: C024 V2 stacked six longitudinal lines on non-bend structure; all six were unmatched.
C030 V2 emitted two aliases of one object; one was true and one was duplicate.
C029 V3 demonstrated that visually overshooting lines can still represent true bend axes; all three were true.
C013 V3 placed three true panel-junction lines and one false outer-rim line.
C019 V3 placed two true lines and one false diagonal cross-part line.
C015 V3 emitted no predictions despite visible wall-to-base junctions.

next_research_tranche.profile: V3 precision core plus source-specific mesh-adjacency recall route
